title_en: The Status of the Intellectually and Ideologically Impaired (Mustad'af) Regarding Hereafter Punishment, Episode 7
description_en: The status of the intellectually and ideologically impaired (mustad'af) regarding hereafter punishment, part 7, from advanced lessons in principles of jurisprudence (usul al-fiqh) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure).
summary: This lesson analyzes the theological criteria for evaluating the fate of the mustad'af in the afterlife.
series_en: The Status of the Intellectually and Ideologically Impaired (Mustad'af) Regarding Hereafter Punishment
